final_review.suggestions: To fix aggregates without GROUP BY: after WHERE, if any select item is an AggregateCall, wrap all filtered rows into one group, compute aggregates, and return a single row; also raise an ExecutionError if any non-aggregate column is present without GROUP BY. For GROUP BY: before grouping, verify that every non-aggregate selected column is listed in GROUP BY; raise an error otherwise. Rewrite INNER JOIN per the implementation plan: qualify all row keys with 'table_name.' prefix before joining; use nested-loop join with exact key lookups; resolve unqualified columns by searching for unique suffix among qualified keys; remove all broken helper functions like _find_table_for_column, _get_qualified_value, _find_table_for_columns, etc. Optionally clean up unused imports and long lines, but priority is fixing the broken features.
